reviews.author: tom mcadams
reviews.text: Class A Autobody exceeded my expectations. I brought my car in for repairs and the staff were great. My main contact was Karen and she was absolutely amazing. She was friendly, kind, knowledgeable and provided great communication during the process. My car looked brand new when I picked it up. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: VISH RAMDIN
reviews.text: I had an outstanding experience at A-Class Auto Body with my Acura EV Repair. The repair team communicated clearly from pre-repair through post-repair and set clear expectations around both the process and the timeline. I received consistent updates throughout, and my vehicle was returned in like-new condition. I would absolutely recommend this location to anyone looking for high-quality auto body work.

reviews.author: Sophia Ramnan
reviews.text: My first visit with Class A Auto Body, they exceeded my expectations. Staff very professional and understanding. Greeting from Dave Assistant Manager very pleasant and welcoming. Staff kept me informed and provided updates via text messages during the repair process for my Toyota Camry. I will use their services in the future and recommend for someone who is looking for professionals to handle their vehicle needs.

reviews.author: AnmiLis Ortiz
reviews.text: Awesome!! Everyone here are super awesome super friendly..the ladies in the front walked me each step with the repair process...best customer service i have ever experienced! Upon receiving my car the staff also completed a full car wash..body work came out amazing. Im very satisfied and pleased that I chose this business. Best customer service..

reviews.author: Bobby Johnson
reviews.text: I got rear ended on 12/21/25 and my insurance company used this business for my repairs, I’m sure glad they did. This has been the most pleasant and easiest experience I had ever had with a auto body shop,Staff was extremely helpful and knowledgeable, they answered all my questions and walked me through the entire process throughout the whole repair. My service advisor was Dave F. He knew exactly how to handle my concerns and he even helped me talk my insurance adjuster. The condition they returned. My vehicle was better then before I even had my accident. I definitely recommend Class A autobody for repairs.

reviews.author: Ap H
reviews.text: Great work and done ahead of schedule! Staff was very friendly, and great communication throughout the process made things very easy after my accident.

reviews.author: Robert Marshall
reviews.text: If I could give them zero stars, I would. This place is extremely unprofessional. If you happen to work with someone named Dave, beware of slow responses and misleading promises. He claimed my car had been restored to “like new,” but that couldn’t have been further from the truth. After waiting five weeks for what was supposed to be a complete repair, my car still wasn’t fixed. When I tried to get an updated price to finish the work elsewhere, I never received a follow-up. On top of that, items were missing from the exterior of my car, they suggested I “just buy replacements on Amazon”, and even a personal bumper sticker was taken. Overall, I would strongly advise against bringing your car here. They seem far more interested in taking your money than in doing quality work or treating customers with respect.

reviews.author: Sal Khorami
reviews.text: My car was sent here by StateFarm auto insurance as they are an authorized repair shop. Initial repair went smooth, right up until the day of pick up which the process was weird. They first had me come in and sign all the documents and then took me outside to inspect the car. I noticed something wrong with the rear passenger side door lock, so I brought it to their attention and immediately they took it back inside. I noticed they didn’t care to repair my front bumper that had damaged from the accident, made that know more than one time. Now fast forward 2 weeks and I decided to open the window on the door that had the lock situation and the mirror won’t come back up…..it’s 29 degrees Fahrenheit and I am in a different state. On top of all this I have my dog that travels with me and I do not know how I’m going to get back home with this problem that was caused by Class A Autobody. Took my car to a glass repair shop and they said the door was missing brackets that would’ve held my mirror. And guess what I found 4 brackets in the door pocket holder. Thanks for the safety check class A!

reviews.author: Errol Deyro
reviews.text: I had a brand-new car at the time of the accident, and I’m so glad I chose Class A Autobody. The results were excellent, my car looked like new again. The staff, especially Karen, kept me updated throughout the entire process and addressed all my concerns, down to the smallest detail. The staff was excellent. If given the chance I would highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Ann Dumasig
reviews.text: I had a really great experience with Class A Autobody after my car was rear-ended. They made the whole process easy and stress-free, and the repairs came out amazing, my car looks good as new. A big thank you to Karen for being so helpful throughout everything. She was friendly, patient, and kept me updated every step of the way, especially with the insurance process. She really went above and beyond to make sure everything was taken care of. I definitely recommend Class A Autobody if you need repairs. Great service and great people!

reviews.author: Elisa Gonzalez
reviews.text: I had such a great experience at Class A Auto Body. Karen and the staff were so nice and genuinely caring from drop-off to pick-up. I was updated throughout the entire process via text messages and even got my car back a few days earlier than expected. My car had exterior repairs done, and it looks brand new. They were transparent, kind, and made everything as easy as possible on my end. I am very happy with my experience and highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Sharon Park
reviews.text: Hello, I don’t usually write reviews, but I decided to leave one because I truly wanted to express my gratitude to Karen and Robert, as well as the kind lady at the front desk. My Polestar has unfortunately been involved in two car accidents, and both times I brought it to Class A Auto Body. Every single experience has been wonderful. They were always professional, kind, and incredibly sweet to my daughter. While my car was being repaired, I was using a rental car, and on one occasion, I accidentally locked myself out of my house, leaving my daughter and me stranded without access to either our home or the car keys. Robert personally brought my spare house key, which he had with my car key, to my home so we could get inside. I was truly touched by his kindness. I don’t know much about cars, so whenever I’ve had big or small issues related to my vehicle, I didn’t always know where to ask for advice. Despite having no obligation or benefit to do so, they never once made me feel like a burden and always responded patiently and kindly. Karen was also thoughtful enough to wish my daughter a happy birthday after I mentioned it in passing, which meant a lot to us. I am deeply grateful for their genuine care and support, and I highly recommend Class A Auto Body to anyone looking for trustworthy and compassionate service.

reviews.author: Kristen Rivas
reviews.text: Car was repaired quicker than they originally promised. Not only did they repair the damaged mirror and door, they detailed the whole car inside and out.

reviews.author: David Garcia
reviews.text: Great place with very nice people! Tony got my car looking brand new again. I’m really happy with the results and the service. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Emily Evans
reviews.text: Amazing customer service and their quality of work is perfect! I was referred here for repairs after my accident and I would 100% recommend to others. Karen was very helpful and kept me updated on each detail of the service. I was very happy with the repairs and the car looks brand new!

reviews.author: Joel (Rosayjay)
reviews.text: Tony and the team did an amazing job on my car, very kind people! Would definitely recommend getting work done here.

reviews.author: Detechno
reviews.text: 5 star no brainer. My car was in and out after it got backed into. Karen went above and beyond and make sure insurance company got everything they need to process claim, rental . Definitely top a class autobody.

reviews.author: Bella Maria
reviews.text: As a younger individual with limited knowledge about cars, I was initially unsure of what to expect when dealing with auto repairs. However, the team at this auto body shop was incredibly patient and supportive throughout the entire process. They took the time to explain each step to me, ensuring that I fully understood the work being done. Their professionalism and dedication to customer service were truly outstanding. I greatly appreciate their guidance and would highly recommend their services to anyone in need of reliable and transparent auto repair.

reviews.author: isabella g
reviews.text: I recently brought my car to Class A in Hackensack and I couldn't be more impressed with the entire experience. From the moment I walked in, I felt genuinely welcomed and valued as a customer. The staff was incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and took the time to thoroughly explain the repair process, which immediately put my mind at ease. The service was nothing short of exceptional. They kept me updated at every stage of the repair, ensuring I knew exactly what was going on. The work itself was meticulous, my car looks as good as new, with every detail restored to perfection. It's clear that they take pride in their craft and go above and beyond to ensure customer satisfaction. I left feeling like my vehicle was in the hands of true professionals who genuinely care about their work and their customers. If you’re looking for top-notch autobody repairs, I highly recommend Class A Autobody. They’ve earned my trust and future business!

reviews.author: ERIKA NEAL
reviews.text: If I could give them 10 stars, I would!!! . From the moment I walked in, I was greeted by Melody super friendly and very welcoming, I worked with Rob who was very professional! they made sure to keep me updated throughout the entire process. They were able to fix my car quickly and efficiently, and the quality of their work was exceptional. I was impressed with their attention to detail and their commitment to ensuring that I was completely satisfied with the finished product. Overall, I highly recommend quality of work is top notch. Thank you Class A!

reviews.author: Anushka Joshi
reviews.text: They have incredible service and are very fridndly and professional! Rob worked on my car after I got rear ended and he was super thorough with updates and the job. They regularly called and texted to keep me updated on estimate date it would be fixed and they actually were done a few days early. I was out of town so couldn’t pick up and they kept the car until I was ready to pick it up. They were always super responsive when I called and they explained everything really well. The itemized bill was also very detailed and the process with the insurance was very easy because Class A handled it. Would definitely trust them with my car and bring it back here again for regular maintenance or if anything were to happen.

reviews.author: Logan Chambers
reviews.text: wow wow WOW!! the team at Class A Auto on railroad is amazing!!! I got rear ended and put off getting it fixed because it’s always stressful. The ladies up front (melodie and karen) were so helpful and so amazing! karen went out of her way to be as spot on with the expected date of finish, and she sure did awesome! Her communication was THE BEST!! i will recommend class A to everyone in need

reviews.author: Savannah S
reviews.text: I came here with my mother to fix her car door that was damaged in an accident a few years ago. The place is super organized, their waiting area is very nice and it does not even feel like you are at a body shop. :) It is beautiful. The people who helped us were very nice and to the point. They did an excellent job with the car. Would highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Roberto Diaz
reviews.text: Class A gave me hopes again that there is great, high quality auto body shops that work to perfection. I’ve used a couple different shops throughout the time and none come even close to how detailed and amazing of a job class A does! I recently dropped off my Honda accord there from a hit and run incident -_- as soon as I walked in I knew I was in the right place. Service is amazing, Dave explained everything nice and easy and job was done within a week. You won’t be disappointed.

reviews.author: Alicia Collins
reviews.text: This was the most organized and efficient body shop I have ever used. They were communicative friendly and did an amazing job on my repair in a timely manner. Could not more highly recommend.

reviews.author: Edward Lew
reviews.text: I wish I had before and after photos illustrating its quality work. There are some reviews I've read professing how rude the front office can be. I, too, was afraid of being treated rudely. However, my concerns weren't borne out. The shop does do quality work. Any consumer can make judgment by the cars it works on. I can certainly go to closer bodyshops to me, but when you find one like Class A, my fears are alleviated. Sometimes, a little patience and diplomacy go a long way. At first, I feared I was also being treated unfairly. However, coming from an aspect where customer service is crucial, take a deep breath and be patient. It goes a long way. Dave is great. You won't be disappointed. There are days they can be quite busy, so a little patience goes quite far for quality workmanship. I've worked for BMW at its port facility in Jersey City on brand new cars brought over from Germany. Extremely comparative. The choice is yours. Don't lose out. Squeak out the details. You're the customer. Class A will be worth it.

reviews.author: Devon Karvan
reviews.text: My truck was stolen and upon recovery was taken to class A for repairs. The entire staff was so kind and informative. The process was incredibly easy, as they took care of everything and kept me in the loop. They went above and beyond to make sure that my car looked brand new when I got it back. Truly outstanding service, I would highly recommend their services!

reviews.author: Matthew DeMarco
reviews.text: I trusted class a Autobody to repair my vehicle after a traumatic car accident. They released it to me and I thought all was well, until the check engine light came back on. I brought it back expecting they can help, and they did a “inspection” and couldn’t figure out what was wrong and told me they can’t do anything else to help me . I brought it to my dealership and found the EVAP canister was completely cracked, in exactly the spot of the accident . I paid class a Autobody a lot of money out of pocket and trusted them to fix my vehicle. After countless emails and calls I still have yet to hear back from them regarding anything they can do to make this situation right. I also had to spend thousands at the dealership just to confirm what they failed to find. I cannot stress to you how disappointed I am with my experience and I sincerely hope I can update this review after class a Autobody reaches out to me and fixes this mistake that has cost me thousands of dollars.UPDATE: . There was no reimbursement , apologies, or assistance offered for their failure to catch the cracked EVAP canister in the exact location of the accident, and their customer service and support was unsatisfactory. AVOID.

reviews.author: GiA Loretta
reviews.text: Class A and Karen are both the best she’s very knowledgeable and cares about the customers and it shows in quality of work they do. Thank you

reviews.author: Michael Sears
reviews.text: My car was recently hit with a rock while driving on I-95. The damage to the passenger side door and rear quarter panel was severe with large dents and paint removal. After being told by another shop that a new door would be needed, I checked in with Class A. They put in the effort to repair the damage without replacing the door. The result is perfect. No one could possibly guess that there was every any damage! They even washed and cleaned the exterior and interior before handing back the keys. Highly recommend this shop. Very professional and capable!

reviews.author: Kay Murgado
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience with this Autobody. We have used them 3 times (not our fault) but the employees go above and beyond to help. Karen kept us updated with everything and Melody answered any questions I had regarding any insurance claims/help. You can hear her smile over the phone. They both seemed very happy to help.

reviews.author: A Sanchez
reviews.text: Outstanding service! Dave Fletcher kept me updated on the progress from start to finish. Everyone was kind and professional. My car was returned earlier than expected. Rear bumper replaced in two days. They went the extra mile and removed some scratches from around my car for free. All parts replaced on my Tahoe were original ordered from the manufacturer. Definitely recommend this place!

reviews.author: Soying Eng
reviews.text: Good customer service and outstanding workmanship! Class A autobody is the best Autobody shop, it deserves more than five stars. This place is absolutely amazing from the start to finish. The people are friendly, nice and good at communicating with customers. They also updated the progress during the repair via text. Excellent workmanship! After the repair was completed, my car was cleaned both inside and outside. The color of the car is completely matched. My car looks like a new car! The repair statement is very clear and detailed. They also stated that the repair has a lifetime warranty. I highly recommend the ClassA to anyone who needs repairs. Thanks to Melody (the front desk), and Chris ( management team) and, Gary and the team (repair team) !

reviews.author: Teikesha Hubert
reviews.text: I recently had a terrible experience at Class A Autobody shop and would strongly advise against anyone using their services. The staff were incredibly rude and unprofessional, and I was left feeling completely disrespected and undervalued as a customer. From the moment I walked in, I was met with hostility from one of the staff member, Melody, who claimed that I had rubbed them the wrong way in the past. I was shocked by this response, as she was the one who did not confirm the drop off of my car by calling me to inform me that the parts have arrived as she promised she would. To make matters worse, the staff seemed to be under the impression that my husband and I were sitting in our car outside, when in reality we were standing in the entryway. We overheard Melody call me Satan since I rubbed her the wrong way the last time. To add insult to injury, I noticed that an Asian family who came in after me was treated with much more respect and courtesy. Melody was polite and friendly to them, and took the time to explain all the necessary documents. When it was my turn, I was simply handed my papers from Karen and given no further information. I was then forced to wait over an hour as the staff refused to believe me or the Progressive lady that the payment had been issued. When they finally called for my car, they brought out the wrong vehicle, causing further delays and frustration. To top it off, they brought the Asian family's car right up to the front door, but left mine far away in the rain. When I asked about the warranty, I was met with confusion and incompetence. The staff member I spoke to, Karen, seemed completely unaware of the details and offered to get the manager, Chris, for me. Overall, my experience at Class A Autobody shop was a complete disaster, and I would not recommend them to anyone. Progressive should remove them from their preferred bodyshop list.

reviews.author: Vin Milack
reviews.text: My wife and I brought her car to Class A Autobody after reading many reviews. As most of the reviews stated, the quality of work was great and the time frame for completing the job was above our expectations. As for the price, it was comparable to the other estimates we obtained. Dave was excellent, very professional and explained everything to us in detail. He had a genuine concern in making the entire process as smooth as possible.

reviews.author: Justin
reviews.text: Exceptional work, car felt like it was brand new when I got it back. Needed some body work done due to an accident I had while on a trip. Dave was a pleasure to work with and kept me posted on the status of my car throughout the whole process - the work took longer than originally anticipated but Dave was on top of it, and took care of everything involving the insurance. Melody was also pleasant to speak with as well on the few occasions we did. I would highly recommend Class A to anyone and will be taking my car here going forward, great group of people. I would give them more than 5 stars if I could. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Scott Quiana
reviews.text: I do not write a lot of reviews. As a matter of fact this is my first on Google but had to say something. Brought in an Audi A4 with rear and side panel damage. I do not have a lot of experience with auto body shops but if you have a high end car and are looking for high end service and high quality work then this is the place. From making the appointment, to the turn around time, the handling with insurance and the quality of work I was blown away by how seamless it all was. The car was returned cleaner then when I brought it in (inside and out). I was really skeptical and concerned that the quality was going to be where I wanted. This will be my go to place for any work in the future as well as family and friends. Very impressed. Dave and team were rockstars

reviews.author: Camille
reviews.text: I have had worked with Class A auto body twice and they truly work to live up to their name. They provide friendly customer service, did a superb job repairing my mercedes c 300 car door. Washed and detailed it before returning its which was above and beyond my expectations. I hope to have no additional accidents, however, I will indeed choose to work with them, if I do. They also work closely with progressive and enterprise, so my car rental was quick and easy with no wait.

reviews.author: Jill Brave
reviews.text: They are called Class A for a reason! Great experience from start to finish...they took care of everything and made it as pleasant as can be after a recent car accident. The receptionist, Melody, was friendly and efficient. Gary, my service rep, explained everything fully and kept me in the loop until my car was ready for pick-up (which was earlier than I expected!) Top-notch auto shop! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jason Weiss
reviews.text: I don't have too much experience with auto body shops but I came away seriously impressed with Class A Autobody. When I called to make an appointment, I was given a guesstimate of a week turnaround, based on what's typical for that kind of repair. I brought my car in and was quoted 4-5 days once they saw it. They actually had all of the parts replaced and painted, and the car cleaned inside and out, looking perfect just one day after I brought it in. I was really amazed and pleased by that. Highly, highly recommended!

reviews.author: P Smith
reviews.text: Great customer service. Melody, the receptionist, was professional, knowledgeable, courteous and helpful. Thanks to Lou, he was timely with the repair estimate. I appreciated the timely updates as the repair progressed. Exceptional work on the car. The work was completed in the time frame I was given. I was impressed with the result when I picked up my car. The car looked brand new. Thanks to the team at Class A Auto body, Railroad Ave, Hackensack, NJ. This will the place to go If needed. Due to my great experience, I highly recommend Class A Auto body.

reviews.author: Diana Loaiza
reviews.text: I just picked up my car at Class A Autobody and I was truly satisfied since day 1 with the professionalism of the place starting with Melody then Bill they both made my experience very pleasant. Car was ready before the time frame, work was well done, they communicate often about the progress in the reparations, and facilitate the whole process in the middle of this new social distancing approach. I truly recommend this place they are reliable, punctual, professional. Don't' have any doubts about using their services in the future.

reviews.author: Rachel Peralta
reviews.text: From start to finish, the staff at Class A Autobody were very professional, friendly, and really easy to work with. Receiving updates via text kept us well informed of the progress of the work. They were able to finish the work on our car a week early!!!! Would definitely use them again. Would recommend them to family, friends, and everyone!!! Thanks again!

reviews.author: Frederic Doyen
reviews.text: Amazing customer service and super easy communication throughout the quote and repair process. Also they were able to take my car earlier than originally announced to accomodate the fact I was out of town for a few days and did not need my car, which saved me the cost of a rental car during the repair. And last but not least, I'm almost happy I got bumped into by somebody and needed this repair as my 2015 car now looks almost new, thanks to the amazing job they did ! ;-)

reviews.author: Cesar Coba
reviews.text: These guys did some great work and they were very flexible. The same day that my car was damaged (some very significant damage at that), they were able to accommodate me within 2 hours to get my car into the shop. The service manager was courteous and helpful. I've been to other body shops where folks have given nothing but attitude as if I were imposing on them. Not here, they helped explain the process and the repairs they would be performing. An estimate was given to me the next day and work was scheduled almost immediately. They gave me an estimated completion time of 3 weeks but they finished and handed back the car in 2 weeks. They performed a walkthrough of the car when they handed it back to ensure that it was given back to me in pristine condition. The body work was very well done. I'm pleased with the results and my car looks like it has not been damaged at all. I would highly recommend these guys if you're in an accident or just need general work done to your car.

reviews.author: Bayan Khalighi
reviews.text: They work fast, and quality is good. I got rear-ended, and needed to replace my rear bumper. Dropped my car off on Monday, was ready for pickup on Wednesday. They organized a rental as well and are state-farm preferred shop so everything will go smoothly and quickly with the claim. Will come back here again!

reviews.author: Marcela Gonzalez
reviews.text: This place was absolutely amazing from start to finish. It was great!!! This is a place that really stands out in customer service!!! I give them a 120%%. I love it!!!! The repairs were done with ease and my car the front looks absolutely amazing like new!!! I will be coming back for further repairs. I highly recommend this shop to anyone who needs repairs!!! They will give you the best of them and they are highly dedicated!!! A++++++( not to mention I couldn’t recognize my car when I saw it. I was in shock!!! Absolutely amazing) WOW!!!

reviews.author: Yaron Habot
reviews.text: Superb service, you get the car in and within 10 minutes you are on your way out, picked up by car rental agent. You get frequent text messages with the status and a link to a website where you see the repair cost estimate and the repair progress. After the repair is done, you get the car back, clean and in perfect working order with no sign of the accident.

reviews.author: Max
reviews.text: Seriously awesome group of people. Incredibly polite, friendly and extremely accommodating. I didn't have to do anything except bring the car there and pick it up. They worked with the rental car company and insurance company on my behalf. Nobody likes getting into an accident and having to deal with repairs, but everyone here makes the process as easy as they can for you! Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Yousuf Tashfeen
reviews.text: It is a nice experience, i got email every second about my car and they sent me pictures of my car on every second step when completed. they gave me 10 to 15 business days to complete the job but they finished in just 10 days. Trust me my car looks brand new. Thanks Class A auto body and their staff hats off to you you done a very good job.

reviews.author: Shan Carter
reviews.text: They are the best in the business! Sadly, I've been hit several times and I only trust them to handle my car. The process is very simple from beginning to end. I love how they keep you updated, every step of the way. Even with the current state of events due to covid, it was a seamless, cleanliness process! I love them, 10 million stars

reviews.author: DA HOBBYISTS
reviews.text: Such an awesome place. The guy I dealt with was Hugo who was very knowledgeable and caring. The receptionist was very warm funny and very informative. Not many places that are left here in North Jersey that deserves a 5.5 rating this is definitely one of them. I would recommend anyone to use this shop. They even did the little extra things Such as little spots that were on the car they just filled in and cleaned up. I only went there just for a bumper accident. And to see them do those little things meant so much.

reviews.author: Kat Shim
reviews.text: Recently got into a minor accident and went to Class A based on Google reviews. They did not disappoint! Excellent work in timely manner. Also, they have Geico onsite so it made dealing with insurance company smooth. They also work with rental car company (Enterprise) so it was really convenient. Owner was nice and thorough and explained all with itemized estimate. Definitely made stressful situation so much easier. Pricing was very reasonable as well. Staff was nice and on top of things.

reviews.author: Abel Gongora
reviews.text: I had a accident with my 2018 ford edge, the damage was minor but with newer cars it's always significant. I had researched body shops and I had 2 places which were reviewed in a positive way, One was Class A! After getting the ball rolling my insurance company they gave there recommendations on local places and Class A was rated well by the them. I felt they were the right choice, I spoke to Bill, a true gentlemen and he honestly assest the damage and explained the replacment and repair process, a true professional. I just recieved my car back and they did a spectacular job, there are no complaints and now I have a place to recommend any one that needs repairs. Thank you, and well done, my complete recomendation is given.

reviews.author: Rene Cardona
reviews.text: Firstly, I reside in Teaneck, brought my vehicle to this place for a slight fender bender. I guess I just liked the reviews. Well I am glad I did. The gentleman named David came out and gave me a reasonable estimate which I agreed to. He said he would repair it in about an hour because there were no significant damage. I informed him that I was going to browse the area. In about about 15 minutes I received a call to come back the repair was done. Upon my arrival I planned to pay the estimated charge and was informed the THERE WOULD BE NO CHARGE. David said he could not charge me for something that was that not difficult or time consuming. I insisted that he take some kind of payment and he emphatically REFUSED, he said “NO WAY” he could charge me. Tried to give his partner a donation for the crew he also refused. One more thing they I forgot to mention, they repaired and also buffed scratches from the bumper AGAIN no charge. To sum it up these are pretty honest professionals, I WOULD definitely bring my vehicle to them If I ever needed repairs (hopefully not). I guess it was surprisingly my lucky day.

reviews.author: Shirley Beattie
reviews.text: My car door was hit by someone, and as insurance company recommended, I brought my car to Class A Autobody for repair. They did such a great job within a 4 days time frame. The car looks new again, I am very happy!

reviews.author: Brian Sinclair
reviews.text: I've unfortunately been involved in several rear end accidents over the past few years. Each time, I've taken my car to this repair shop. They are friendly, dependable, and they do an awesome job - one that is backed up with a warranty.

reviews.author: Damian Kulesza
reviews.text: The estimate they gave me felt a bit long but they did end up fixing the car a day early so that was nice. Create customer service and the front desk people were nice. Was surprised they did a basic detail of the car before giving it back which was really nice of them.

reviews.author: Gregory Topf
reviews.text: Fantastic work. Reasonable price, work was done ahead of schedule. Excellent communications. Very pleased. We have used you in the past and always been pleased with the quality of the work and have used you on vehicles ranging from a Ford Focus to a brand new Audi.

reviews.author: Anthony B
reviews.text: Came here based on a recommendation after a fender bender on my wife’s 2019 Audi and glad I did. Bill took care of me and the professionalism exhibited was second to none. Was worried about my car being white the paint work was A+ and fit and finish was excellent. I was so worried and they finished the car a day before it was scheduled. Couldn’t be happier. Will now be taking all my cars there moving forward.

reviews.author: Lorena Mejia
reviews.text: Melody was great. She was very friendly throughout my whole experience with Class A Autobody. I received emails updating me of the status of my vehicle. Dave was also very helpful and friendly. I would definitely recommend Class A Autobody to my friends and family. Thank you so much for making such a good turn out of my misfortune.

reviews.author: Kochin Chang
reviews.text: In my over 30-year driving, I have only dealt with a handful body shops. But, in my limited experiences, Class A Autobody is the most professional and courteous shop I have ever sent our car to. From the beginning Melody had been very patient and friendly when she contacted me and explained to me the repair process. When they sent a tow truck from McGee's to pick up my wife's car, the driver looked inside the car and helpfully reminded us to retrieve personal items and EZ-Pass. During the time my wife's car in the shop, they texted me regularly regarding estimate and repair updates. When my wife was concerned about her car's repair, Melody arranged a meeting with Dave for us. Dave was very kind to show and explain to us what they would do to make the car new again even though he had to stop other workers for a short while so that we could hear him clearly. The whole repair took about a week. When we picked up the car, Dave assured us that Class A Autobody totally stands behind their work quality. We have been driving the car for about a week. So far we don't have any issues with the car, and it just looks and drives like new. Two thumbs up to Class A Autobody!

reviews.author: natalie campoverde
reviews.text: My car came out better then expected, I would always receive text messages on how the process was going. I honestly would recommend this place to my friends & family. Super friendly staff, I never right reviews but I just had to for the service I received with them! You guys were the best

reviews.author: Jim Ryu
reviews.text: I had my SUV repaired here. Bill and everyone I met were extremely friendly and professional. When I could not pick up the car due to a schedule conflict, offered to deliver the car. Excellent job on the repair. Couldn’t be happier.

reviews.author: Beverly
reviews.text: Just great service! My car was fixed in a very timely manner, and Robert was exceptional with keeping me updated with the status of my car. I already recommended them to several friends of mine.

reviews.author: Susan King
reviews.text: I’ve used Class A several times. They are the best. Work is superb and I love how they keep me updated with texts. Always had my car ready ahead of schedule. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Sarah Chappell
reviews.text: I'm so glad I chose Class A Autobody to repair my car after a collision! They finished the work days ahead of schedule, and the quality of the work was excellent. All of the staff I spoke with were really nice and were happy to answer any questions I had!

reviews.author: Claire Banks
reviews.text: I simply cannot express my gratitude to Dave and the rest of the team at Class A autobody. My car flooded in the September 1st storm and I had a really hard time getting in touch with my insurance because of the number of claims that were filed. I finally was assigned to an auto shop and it happened to be Class A, where I met Dave. He called me every day to check on the status of my claim with the insurance to see when I could bring the car in for service. he went above and beyond to ensure my car was actually fixed and that the claim was taken seriously by Progressive. I seriously don't know what I would have done without him. When my insurance company failed me, Dave stepped up to the plate and made suer my car was not forgotten about. I picked up my car today with brand new carpets thanks to Class A. after 5 weeks, I can finally put this nightmare behind me and it's all thanks to Dave and Class A!

reviews.author: Kristine Haboran
reviews.text: Your first impression comes from Melanie. She is informative and very sweet and puts you at ease right away. The guys who fix the vehicle do a wonderful job and are on spot with when they say the car will be ready. I recommend class A auto body as a great shop that does a fantastic job.

reviews.author: jon v
reviews.text: They don't communicate well. I had to Call up almost everyday to know what was going on. I was going through insurance so only good about them is you explain how accident happened and you don't have to wait for any other adjuster. Other than that I did not like their service. I get an estimate and when I get there the bill is close to 300 over original estimate. It was explained and made sense but I felt like that shouldve been explained in original estimate. Car also took 3 day's longer than estimated which meant longer car rental and again I wouldnt have known about delay if I hadn't called to confirm finish date. Very frustrating.

reviews.author: Yeon Kim
reviews.text: I had so many different mercedes for 30 years, this body shop is far better than any other authorized Mercedes body shop. All staffs are so nice and professional. Especially talk to Mr. Gary Magllanez, he will do superior job for you.

reviews.author: Steven Ta
reviews.text: This is actually my second or third time here. Just got in for my 4:30, and they accommodated me right away. I was actually earlier by maybe 15 minutes. They're quick with estimates and fair with pricing. If your insurance won't pay for your vehicle entirely ask them for alternative options. They're extremely helpful. This time I tried direct messaging via Google and they responded within minutes. 5 out of 5 service, no question.

reviews.author: A Green
reviews.text: Over priced. Not at all sure why they get reviews that don't say that.... paid $400 less to get a dent out with another mechanic who said the same thing (that it would require a bit more work and basically repainting half the car...) So at least they're honest. But always get a second opinion. (In fact its probably worth it to get their quote - then take it to someone else and ask them if they can beat it by a few hundred and they will)

reviews.author: Rolly Capistrano
reviews.text: Class A Autobody is really the best repair shop there is. The employees, workers and the manager itself were very professional, prompt and accommodating. They directly deal with your problem without alibi, they make it sure that the repair be done on time and in my case it was done a day earlier. The repair outcome was outstanding indeed so I am very much satisfied and I highly recommend the "CLASS A AUTOBODY" to everyone!!!

reviews.author: Dion
reviews.text: Very professional group of people. I had no rental so they ordered the parts in advance for the repairs. I was told it would take 8 days and was done in 3 days! Super fast, great quality and friendly group of people. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Dan F.
reviews.text: Friendly service and my vehicle was ready earlier than I expected it would be. When I took my vehicle to the dealership for service after the work Class A did, they even told me that the repair was spot on and their techs were surprised it wasn't all original parts. Would definitely recommend

reviews.author: Robert Pisani

reviews.author: michael smith
reviews.text: You guys did an awesome job with my car. it was fixed within a week and your staff is friendly and courteous. my car looks like a new car when I got it back. thanks again for your great service.

reviews.author: Michael Fleming

They ended up holding onto my car even after it was done without charging me a storage fee as I waited for the insurance check.
